devdoc.author: Venus Protocol
devdoc.details: This contract is deployed using the clones pattern for gas efficiency.      It allows the RelativePositionManager to execute calls on behalf of the user.      The constructor sets immutable values shared across all clones.      The initialize function sets clone-specific data.      DESIGN INVARIANT - External Token Transfers & Accounting Drift:      Do not call mintBehalf or perform direct transfers to this contract. Use only the RelativePositionManager.      External transfers to this account are not accurately tracked by the manager, causing accounting drift.      No funds are lost, only accounting can drift. All operations must be routed through the RelativePositionManager      to maintain accurate accounting.

params.owner: Address of the position account owner receiving the dust
params.token: Address of the ERC20 token transferred

params.collateralAmount: Amount of collateral to redeem for swap

params.amount: Flash loan amount for debt repayment
params.market: vToken market (collateral and debt are the same)

Initialized(uint8).details: Triggered when the contract has been initialized or reinitialized.

params.vToken: Address of the vToken market exited

constructor.custom:error: ZeroAddress if any of the addresses is zero.
constructor.details: This constructor is only called once for the implementation contract.      Sets immutable values that are the same for all clones.

enterLeverage(address,uint256,address,ui.custom:error: UnauthorizedCaller if caller is not the RelativePositionManager.
enterLeverage(address,uint256,address,ui.details: Only callable by the RelativePositionManager. Ensures the position account is msg.sender to LM,      so debt/collateral and dust stay on this account. Emits EnterLeverageForwarded for debugging.

params.borrowedAmountToFlashLoan: Amount to borrow via flash loan
params.collateralAmountSeed: Optional seed amount of collateral (RPM uses 0)
params.collateralMarket: Collateral (e.g. long) vToken to supply after swap
params.minAmountOutAfterSwap: Minimum collateral out after swap (slippage protection)

exitLeverage(address,uint256,address,uin.custom:error: UnauthorizedCaller if caller is not the RelativePositionManager.
exitLeverage(address,uint256,address,uin.details: Only callable by the RelativePositionManager. Ensures the position account is msg.sender to LM,      so debt/collateral and dust stay on this account. Emits ExitLeverageForwarded for debugging.

params.borrowedAmountToFlashLoan: Amount to repay via flash loan
params.collateralAmountToRedeemForSwap: Amount of collateral to redeem for swap
params.minAmountOutAfterSwap: Minimum amount out after swap (slippage protection)

exitMarket(address).custom:error: UnauthorizedCaller if caller is not the RelativePositionManager.ExitMarketFailed if the exit market operation fails.
exitMarket(address).details: Only callable by the RelativePositionManager. The position account directly calls the Comptroller.

params.vTokenToExit: Address of the vToken market to exit

exitSingleAssetLeverage(address,uint256).custom:error: UnauthorizedCaller if caller is not the RelativePositionManager.
exitSingleAssetLeverage(address,uint256).details: Only callable by the RelativePositionManager. Use when collateral and debt are the same asset (e.g. DSA == short).

params.collateralAmountToFlashLoan: Amount to borrow via flash loan for debt repayment
params.collateralMarket: vToken market for both collateral and debt

genericCalls(address[],bytes[]).custom:error: UnauthorizedCaller if caller is not the RelativePositionManager.InvalidCallsLength if arrays are empty or lengths mismatch.
genericCalls(address[],bytes[]).details: Only callable by the authorized RelativePositionManager contract.      Uses AddressUpgradeable.functionCall for safer execution and reverts on failure.

params.data: Array of encoded function call data

initialize(address,address,address).custom:error: ZeroAddress if any of the addresses is zero.
initialize(address,address,address).details: Can only be called once per clone. Sets the owner, long/short vTokens, and delegates to both managers.

params.longVToken_: Address of the long market vToken
params.owner_: Address of the position account owner
params.shortVToken_: Address of the short market vToken

transferDustToOwner(address).custom:error: UnauthorizedCaller if caller is not the RelativePositionManager.
transferDustToOwner(address).details: Only callable by the RelativePositionManager. Used to sweep dust to the position owner.

params.token: Address of the ERC20 token to transfer

devdoc.title: PositionAccount

ExitMarketFailed(uint256).notice: Thrown when exitMarket fails with a non-zero error code

InvalidCallsLength().notice: Thrown when genericCalls is invoked with invalid calls length (empty or lengths mismatch)

UnauthorizedCaller().notice: Thrown when caller is not the authorized RelativePositionManager

ZeroAddress().notice: Thrown when a zero address is provided as a parameter

DustTransferredToOwner(address,address,u.notice: Emitted when dust (remaining token balance) is transferred to the position owner

EnterLeverageForwarded(address,address,u.notice: Emitted when enterLeverage is forwarded to the LeverageManager

ExitLeverageForwarded(address,address,ui.notice: Emitted when exitLeverage is forwarded to the LeverageManager

ExitSingleAssetLeverageForwarded(address.notice: Emitted when exitSingleAssetLeverage is forwarded to the LeverageManager

GenericCallExecuted(address,bytes).notice: Emitted when a generic call is executed

MarketExited(address).notice: Emitted when a market is exited via the Comptroller

COMPTROLLER().notice: Address of the Venus Comptroller (same for all clones)

LEVERAGE_MANAGER().notice: Address of the LeverageStrategiesManager contract (same for all clones)

RELATIVE_POSITION_MANAGER().notice: Address of the authorized RelativePositionManager contract (same for all clones)

constructor.notice: Constructor for the PositionAccount implementation contract

enterLeverage(address,uint256,address,ui.notice: Forwards enterLeverage to the LeverageStrategiesManager on behalf of this position account

exitLeverage(address,uint256,address,uin.notice: Forwards exitLeverage to the LeverageStrategiesManager on behalf of this position account

exitMarket(address).notice: Exits a market by calling comptroller.exitMarket with this position account as the sender

exitSingleAssetLeverage(address,uint256).notice: Forwards exitSingleAssetLeverage to the LeverageStrategiesManager on behalf of this position account

genericCalls(address[],bytes[]).notice: Executes multiple generic calls to external contracts

initialize(address,address,address).notice: Initializes a new position account clone

longVToken().notice: Address of the long vToken for this position

owner().notice: Address of the position account owner (different for each clone)

shortVToken().notice: Address of the short vToken for this position

transferDustToOwner(address).notice: Transfers full balance of an ERC20 token from this position account to its owner (dust recovery)

userdoc.notice: Minimal proxy contract that holds user funds for isolated Relative Trading positions
